🛁 THE SALON

A lovely place to be pampered.

Scruffy 2 Fluffy Salon

Moka’s Groomies is based at Unit 2, Busbie Business Centre, Tannock Street, Kilmarnock, KA1 4DN.

Why choose a hydrobath?

The shared salon advertises three professional hydrobaths. Benefits promoted by the salon include warm water, deep cleaning and a gentler experience. Confirm the equipment available at your appointment with Aimee.

🐾 A FEW HELPFUL DETAILS

Before your visit

Cancellation policy

Please give at least 48 hours’ notice if you need to change your appointment.

Aimee's published policy says cancellations within 48 hours may be charged the full booking cost. Outstanding balances must be settled before another appointment is made.

New customers may be asked for a non-refundable deposit, deducted from their service total.

Our timetable

Monday–Saturday: 9am–5pm.

Saturdays: fully booked well into January 2027, so new bookings are currently closed.

Please ask Aimee to confirm prices, booking durations, cancellation wording and WhatsApp availability before launching.
